text:
emma: Quick heads-up - onboarding sample (Node) diverges from curl docs: SDK strips X-Client-Env and retries POSTs twice, causing duplicate outputs in demos.

noah: can you paste repro?

emma: curl working:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-Client-Env: demo-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text/generate -d '{"model":"lite","input":"hi"}'
```

emma: Node SDK quickstart:
```js
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await c.text.generate({ model: 'lite', input: 'hi' });
```

emma: server logs show no X-Client-Env and two retries on transient 502. curl had none.

priya: looks like header whitelist + retry policy mismatch. Docs show header usage but SDK intentionally strips some X- headers. That's a DX surprise.

noah: action: priya to patch whitelist and add per-call disableRetries; emma to add onboarding note with env workaround REDWOOD_SDK_DISABLE_RETRIES=1; cli-bot to file issue.

cli-bot: Created issue #650: "Node SDK strips X-Client-* headers and retries non-idempotent POSTs by default; onboarding quickstart mismatch" https://github.com/redwood/repo/issues/650

emma: thanks, will update onboarding checklist so partners dont get blocked. :thumbsup:
